scope: Add nominal D435i housing collision to the project model, include revolute x500 rotor collision sweeps in the body-envelope estimate, and recheck the fixed Jazzy/Harmonic sensor fixture.
qualification: Preliminary GOAL F evidence only. This does not measure obstacle-map error, trajectory tracking, stopping distance, minimum clearance, collision-free planning, PX4 behavior, or flight. No acceptance threshold is frozen.

correction_to_previous_audit.finding: The previous calculation used each rotor collision box at its default pose. The pinned x500 SDF attaches those boxes to links driven by Z-axis revolute joints, so the box sweeps around each motor center.

vehicle_collision_envelope.reference_frame: d435i_imu_frame / d435i_link origin, matching /localization/optimized_imu_odom child frame before epoch suffix
vehicle_collision_envelope.d435i_housing_orientation: The 90 mm dimension is mapped to link Y, inferred from the SDF stereo sensors' +/-0.025 m baseline poses on Y.
vehicle_collision_envelope.d435i_housing_dimension_source: Intel RealSense D435i specifications, nominal 90 x 25 x 25 mm
vehicle_collision_envelope.calculation: Enumerate transformed corners for fixed x500 and D435i boxes. For each x500 rotor, use the XY half-diagonal of its rectangular collision box as the swept-disc radius around its revolute-joint center; include its vertical half-thickness. Report the union bounds and maximum radius from the IMU origin.

planner_inflation_comparison.assessment: The current setting remains unchanged and PROVISIONAL. Cell dilation is not a validated physical clearance guarantee; uncertainty, tracking, map error, age and braking are still unmeasured.

sensor_regression.checks: Stereo images and pairing, RGB, depth plane/units, CameraInfo, IMU, frame IDs, fixed TF, advancing clock and monotonic source stamps.

validation.gz_sdf_model_check: PASS: gz sdf -k simulation/models/d435i/model.sdf reported Valid; existing gz_frame_id extension warnings remain.
validation.gazebo_sensor_launch: PASS: source project-root D435i model loaded in the fixed Jazzy/Harmonic container.
validation.geometry_audit_script: PASS: audit_vehicle_envelope.py completed and emitted the recorded envelope; py_compile passed.
validation.project_structure: PASS: python3 tools/project_status.py; structure/design check only.
validation.diff_check: PASS: git diff --check and git diff --cached --check.
validation.build_scope: No ROS code or third-party source changed; the model-only edit was checked through Gazebo runtime sensor regression rather than a colcon rebuild.

excluded_attempts: Standalone gz sdf -k checks for the world and x500 wrapper could not resolve model:// includes because that CLI invocation had no SDF find callback; these checks are excluded. The source-root Gazebo launch successfully resolved the same resources and ran the sensor probe.
limitations: The D435i housing collision is a nominal rectangular approximation and excludes the bracket, cable, connectors and manufacturing variation.
The rotor footprint is the swept union of PX4 SDF collision rectangles, not an independently measured physical propeller envelope.
The static sensor test does not exercise the x500 vehicle, obstacle clearance, planner response, collision contact, PX4, or flight.
Map error, VIO error, tracking error, data age, replan deadline, stopping distance, failure detection/exit time and minimum vehicle spacing remain unmeasured for GOAL F.
next_step: Capture multi-obstacle map geometry and same-run localization/tracking error plus braking distance. Keep 0.099 m PROVISIONAL and do not start formal D/E runs until the full GOAL F configuration is derived and frozen.
